title: Opus for one session or one run, without lifting other guards
why: Your question, Oct 25: can override say 'Opus builders for this part of the plan or this session'? Today it cannot without lifting every other guard too.
note: Checked at claude-settings f463787. Built today: (1) every Opus spawn that Plan, Explore or a builder's try 3 does not cover asks you, one prompt per spawn (guard rule subagent-model-cap, #562). (2) override 15m or override 2h lifts every refusal and ask in the session, Opus included, and reaches subagents; too broad, since it lifts all other guards too. (3) A repo grant: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL set to opus in .claude/settings.local.json with a deadline at most 24 h out (decision opus-grant-expires); raises every spawn in that repo, needs a fresh session, and the write itself asks. Not built: a grant scoped to Opus only, for one session and a time. Advisor pick, Oct 25, not ruled: a second prompt word in the override pass's one home (hooks/override_pass.py), such as 'opus 2h' or 'opus builders 2h', that lifts only subagent-model-cap asks (optionally one role) for this session and its subagents until it expires. 'This part of the plan' is not checkable by a hook; session plus time is. Your word, Oct 25: keep it on the roadmap; brief it when its turn comes.
